title: Systematic development of predictive mathematical models for animal cell cultures
description: Fed-batch culture of antibody-secreting hybridoma cells, with balances for volume, viable/total cells, nutrients, metabolites, mRNA, intracellular assembly, and monoclonal antibody production.

model_assumptions.text: The model is based on the assumption that cell growth depends on the availability of two key nutrients, glucose and glutamine, and the accumulation of two toxic metabolites, lactate and ammonia.
